calls.title: Hublo & GrowthBook Proposal
calls.summary: The team is currently assessing three platforms—Amplitude, LaunchDarkly, and Growth Book—before making a final decision by the end of May to support setup before team vacations in June. Key considerations include the pros and cons of each platform, with Gaëlle emphasizing the importance of balancing deployment speed and user experience for product managers. James offered support for a smooth migration from LaunchDarkly to Growth Book, ensuring adequate resources are allocated for onboarding. The discussion also noted the pricing for Growth Book: €38,000 per year for 10 seats, with the possibility of an on-premise option saving about €5,000. Growing emphasis on experimentation reflects a strategic shift in the business, driving the urgency for the right platform choice.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, LaunchDarkly, Pricing, Experimentation, Feature Flagging, Product Analytics
calls.action_items:
